title: Newtonian-Leibnizian Synthesis & Kinetic Energy (Vis Viva)
summary: Émilie du Châtelet's groundbreaking natural philosophy harmonizing Newtonian experimental mechanics with Leibnizian metaphysics. She established the Principle of Sufficient Reason as the foundation of physical science and proved through Willem 's Gravesande's experiments that kinetic energy (vis viva) is proportional to mass times velocity squared (mv²).
